_comment: Kit-shipped permissions: the WhatsApp MCP tools and the claude.ai Calendar/Gmail connectors are pre-approved so headless runs (scans, commands, shifts) can use them without a human at the terminal. The only shell entries here are two kit scripts, pinned by exact command prefix (Bash and PowerShell, both slash styles) - ask.py and teleport.py, which only message the owner and read local state; general shell and file-write tools are NOT here, they go through allowed_tools in config.json and the approval cards. Applies only after the user accepts the project trust dialog (runbook stage 4b). Personal rule additions land in settings.local.json, never in this file.
